title: Slack rejects a generated message with invalid_blocks once the report grows
symptoms: Small test reports post fine, large ones fail
cause: A message holds at most 50 blocks and a modal or Home tab 100. A section text is capped at 3,000 characters and a section takes at most 10 fields of 2,000 characters each.
fix: Count blocks and truncate text before posting. Split long reports across threaded messages or attach a file.
apply:
for chunk in [blocks[i:i+50] for i in range(0, len(blocks), 50)]:
    client.chat_postMessage(channel=cid, blocks=chunk, text="Report", thread_ts=parent_ts)
affected: Slack Block Kit in messages, modals and Home tabs, as of 2026-10
